title: usm detector v1
description: Schema for .usm/detectors/*.yaml files — declarative detector plugins that extend usm scan. A detector describes how to identify a service/framework from a manifest file, how to extract routes from source, how to parse a data schema, or how to extract infrastructure from IaC files. Built-in detectors use the same shape as user-authored ones.

$id.description: Unique detector identifier (e.g. 'zig', 'go', 'prisma', 'terraform'). Used for override precedence: built-in < .usm/detectors/ files < usmconfig.json detection. A user detector with the same $id as a built-in overrides it.

kind.description: Which scan pass invokes this detector. 'service' detects a service from a manifest file (replaces the package.json hardcode). 'framework' identifies the framework from manifest contents (usually combined with 'service'). 'routes' extracts HTTP routes from source files. 'data-schema' extracts data models (ORM schemas). 'infrastructure' extracts cloud resources from IaC files.

language.description: Language label emitted in the generated service.usm (e.g. 'zig', 'go', 'python', 'typescript'). Use 'n/a' for non-language detectors (data-schema, infrastructure).

runtime.description: Runtime label emitted in the generated service.usm (e.g. 'bun', 'node', 'python', 'go', 'rust', 'prisma', 'terraform', 'docker', 'shared-library').

manifest.description: Glob pattern (relative to repo root) for the manifest file that identifies this detector's target. For 'service'/'framework' kinds this is the language manifest (package.json, go.mod, build.zig.zon). For 'data-schema' it is the schema file glob (prisma/schema.prisma). For 'infrastructure' it is the IaC file glob (infrastructure/**/*.tf). Not required for 'routes' kind when the detector is combined with a 'service' detector that already matched the directory.

frameworks.description: Framework detection rules — string-contains checks against the manifest file contents. The first matching framework wins. If none match, framework is null (service still detected, no routes extracted).

routes.description: Route extraction configuration. Declarative regex patterns by default; a script escape hatch handles convention-based frameworks. patterns and script are mutually exclusive.

extract.description: Extraction configuration for 'data-schema' and 'infrastructure' kinds. Shape depends on kind — see $defs/dataExtract and $defs/infrastructureExtract.

service_type.description: Optional override for the generated service.usm $type field. If omitted, the service rule's kind in usmconfig.json drives the type (as today).

name.description: Framework identifier emitted in the generated service.usm (e.g. 'gin', 'fastapi', 'nextjs', 'zap').

detect.description: Substring to search for in the manifest file contents. Case-sensitive. If this string is present, the framework is identified. For package.json this matches against the raw JSON (so '"express"' matches the dependency key).

regex.description: JavaScript regex (string form) matched against source file contents. Capture groups identified by methodGroup and pathGroup extract the HTTP method and path. Uses the 'gi' flags (global, case-insensitive) by default.

methodGroup.description: 1-based capture group index for the HTTP method. Use 0 when the method is not captured (defaults to GET).

pathGroup.description: 1-based capture group index for the route path.

extensions.description: Source file extensions to scan (e.g. ['.ts', '.js'], ['.go'], ['.py']). Required when using patterns; ignored when using script.

patterns.description: Declarative route extraction regexes. Mutually exclusive with script. At least one pattern required if script is absent.

script.description: Path (relative to repo root) to a .ts/.js module exporting extractRoutes(sourceDir: string, framework: string | null): DetectedRoute[]. Mutually exclusive with patterns. Used for convention-based frameworks (Next.js app/page.tsx) that regex cannot express. The module is dynamically imported at scan time.

routesConfig.description: Exactly one of 'patterns' or 'script' must be present.

regex.description: JavaScript regex (string form) matched against schema file contents. Captures model/entity names.

nameGroup.description: 1-based capture group index for the model name.

models.description: Regex to extract model/entity names from the schema file.

relations.description: Whether to attempt relation extraction (future — not implemented in v1).

enums.description: Whether to extract enum definitions (future — not implemented in v1).

regex.description: JavaScript regex (string form) matched against IaC file contents. Captures resource type and name.

typeGroup.description: 1-based capture group index for the resource type (e.g. 'aws_instance', 'google_compute_instance').

nameGroup.description: 1-based capture group index for the resource name.

resources.description: Regexes to extract infrastructure resources from IaC files.
